PRIMARY VERIFICATION. (1) Semicontinuity: Stacks Project Lemma 36.32.1 (tag 0BDN) states that for f: X -> S proper of finite presentation and F of finite presentation and flat over S, the function s -> dim_{kappa(s)} H^i(X_s, F_s) commutes with arbitrary base change, is upper semi-continuous, and has locally constructible level sets; jumping loci are therefore genuine closed conditions, not artifacts removable by shrinking. (2) The only unconditional positive criterion in that section is Lemma 36.32.4 (tag 0D4E): if R^i f_* F = 0 for i > 0, then f_* F is locally free and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change - for a relative curve and a line bundle this is exactly the h^1 = 0 hypothesis. The two classical licenses are Grauert (h^i constant on a reduced base implies R^i locally free with base change; Hartshorne, Algebraic Geometry, GTM 52, III.12.9) and Grothendieck's cohomology-and-base-change theorem (Hartshorne III.12.11; Mumford, Abelian Varieties, II.5; EGA III 7.7.5). (3) Mechanism: formation of Proj(Sym F) commutes with base change for any quasi-coherent F, so the fibre of P(pi_* L) = Proj(Sym pi_* L) at s is P((pi_* L) tensor kappa(s)), which is the intended |L_s| = P(H^0(X_s, L_s)) if and only if the comparison map (pi_* L) tensor kappa(s) -> H^0(X_s, L_s) is an isomorphism. At a jumping point neither Grauert nor the R^1 = 0 criterion applies, so that isomorphism is unlicensed; the finding is correct as stated and is standard relative algebraic geometry, not a novel obstruction. (4) Repair: the relative divisor/Hilbert scheme Div^d_{C/S} (the relative symmetric product for a smooth relative curve) with the Abel-Jacobi map to Pic^d_{C/S} has fibre over [L_s] the complete linear system |L_s| by construction and needs no base-change hypothesis (Kleiman, 'The Picard scheme', arXiv:math/0504020; ACGH, Geometry of Algebraic Curves I, Ch. IV, where W^r_d and G^r_d are constructed determinantally precisely because h^0 jumps, and C_d -> Pic^d is a projective bundle only in the non-jumping range d >= 2g-1). BITE IN THE CAMPAIGN CASE. deg L = 6 < 2g-1 = 11, so the projective-bundle range does not apply; with chi(L) = 1 from FND-0005 one has h^1(L_s) = h^0(L_s) - 1, so jumping is equivalent to effectivity of the degree-4 bundle omega_C tensor L^{-1} = omega_C^2 tensor W_5^{-1}, a live condition on genus-6 tetragonal curves (effective degree-4 classes form W_4 of dimension 4 inside the 6-dimensional Pic^4, and 4 is the gonality). Where h^0 jumps to 2 the true fibre |L_s| is a P^1 while pi_* L has generic rank 1, so a naive P(pi_* L) records at most a point over that stratum; the ordered-divisor S_6 etale cover would then be formed over the wrong space exactly along the stratum the packet asks to isolate, and component/dimension/stabilizer counts for Z (C66-GEO-Z, C66-GEO-COMP) inherited from it would be wrong there. This audit does not decide whether that stratum is nonempty - that is subproblem C66-GEO-H0 - and the finding is correctly phrased conditionally ('when h^0(L) jumps'). SCOPE SHARPENINGS (no weakening of the finding): the obstruction binds over arbitrary, including non-reduced, bases and on any non-constant-h^0 stratum; it does not bind on the h^0 = 1, h^1 = 0 open, where tag 0D4E licenses the naive construction; and it is a construction-validity obstruction only, not a refutation of the existence or nonemptiness of Z (FND-0005 stands).
